derivation.surface_crossed: feedstock-origin element atoms in each evaporate_* transition's process.cleaned_melt debit, minus same-transition reservoir.fo2_buffer credits; plus the explicit Fe vapour credit of native_fe_metal_partition and native Fe saturation overhead-vapour credits, and oxygen_reservoir_exchange net feedstock-origin atoms: reservoir.fo2_buffer debits outward minus buffer credits returned from process.overhead_gas
derivation.drain_tapped: feedstock-origin element atoms in ledger transition credits to terminal.drain_tap_material, plus the typed Stage-0 native-metal external load
derivation.retained_melt: feedstock-origin atoms in accounts mapped to melt_retained
derivation.retained_redox_buffer: feedstock-origin atoms in reservoir.fo2_buffer; meaning remains under investigation
derivation.other_in_pot_terms: each named current ledger account mapped to an in-pot destination term
derivation.other_terminal_terms: typed current account atoms without an evaporation transition claim; these terms are excluded from ideal-train yield

footnotes: Condensed-film sensible heat below each crossing is neglected relative to latent heat.
Cold-end work uses the seven-node Claude cycle; dry-expander shaft credit is explicit.
Cryogenic sizing is the night-path-only case; day-operation strategy remains deferred.
Melt-offgas O2 sensible duty is charged through S-A to 1000 K, then enters S-B at that post-separator datum.
SiO/CrO2 condenser enthalpy is not sourced in Phase 1a; exclusions are classified without reusing melt-side reaction enthalpy.
Cold-end capacity C is the minimum of compressor mass-flow and refrigeration freeze-rate ratings; the orifice is derived from C.
All kg and USD values are report-edge projections; internal enthalpy arithmetic is mol/s and W.
Hot and mid radiator sections conservatively sum per-species design maxima; the displayed hot peak is a concurrent snapshot maximum.

wall_deposit_sticking_authority.message: Wall routing carried non-authoritative vapour evidence (P2=refused, P4=refused, P4O10=status_bearing, P4O6=refused, PO=refused, PO2=refused); zero wall deposition cannot be certified from that evidence; numerical mass remains computed and ledger-visible, but coating and fouling readouts are non-authoritative. Wall saturation includes EXTRAPOLATED quantities; source bands and reasons remain attached.

fe_stage1.source: engineering-default: baffled Fe condenser presents multiple throat areas downstream of the constriction
fe_stage1.message: Condenser stage wall-deposit surface area follows the configured stage-area ratio; provisional geometry makes deposit/coating readouts status-bearing, not refused.

cr_stage2.source: engineering-default: removable Cr oxide cartridge sits between Fe condenser and SiO baffles with intermediate capture surface
cr_stage2.message: Condenser stage wall-deposit surface area follows the configured stage-area ratio; provisional geometry makes deposit/coating readouts status-bearing, not refused.

sio_stage3.source: engineering-default: removable SiO baffle cartridge needs the largest capture surface among named stages
sio_stage3.message: Condenser stage wall-deposit surface area follows the configured stage-area ratio; provisional geometry makes deposit/coating readouts status-bearing, not refused.

alkali_stage4.source: engineering-default: cyclone separator effective wall area exceeds throat but stays below SiO baffle cartridge
alkali_stage4.message: Condenser stage wall-deposit surface area follows the configured stage-area ratio; provisional geometry makes deposit/coating readouts status-bearing, not refused.

terminal.source: engineering-default: terminal vent/capture area is not the constriction; keep >= throat for follow-on Kn diagnostics
terminal.message: Condenser stage wall-deposit surface area follows the configured stage-area ratio; provisional geometry makes deposit/coating readouts status-bearing, not refused.

surface_geometry_provenance.message: Condenser stage-area ratios include provisional/default geometry; wall-deposit and coating readouts are status-bearing until stage surface areas are certified.

reported_activity_provenance.melt_oxide_gamma_limitation: constant_gamma_table_value with endmember continuity shell starting at asserted X=0.99; gamma is a shipped mid-range constant (CaO/Al2O3/SiO2/TiO2/Cr2O3/MgO/MnO: rounded geometric midpoint of the Sossi & Fegley 2018 Table 2 printed envelope, not a cited point coefficient; Na2O/K2O: cited point anchors); no one-parameter pseudo-binary mid-range regular solution and no A*T*/T temperature scaling of gamma (held for multi-component G^E / MC-5); as X approaches 1 the shell enforces Raoultian a->1 continuously so the former gamma*X to a=1 step (31.1x for Cr) is absent; when valid_range_K is set, a temperature outside that interval remains flux-driving and status-bearing; when valid_range_K is unset, this module attaches no in_domain/out_of_gamma_domain payload
